args.speaker: Elder Oswin
args.text: Slimes and worse roam the fields east of here.

args.speaker: Elder Oswin
args.text: A one-eyed brute rules the clearing; past the gate lies the mine.

args.speaker: Elder Oswin
args.text: Choose a calling from our trainers, and take these potions.

args.speaker: Mira
args.text: Monster parts, potions - I trade in both. Gold for your trophies!

args.speaker: Brann
args.text: Bring me gel, lenses or scrap and I'll brew you a potion.

args.speaker: Mage Trainer
args.text: Fire, frost and a quick step - power has a price in mana.

args.speaker: Mage Trainer
args.text: Press C to open your skill tree. Every level brings two skill points.

args.speaker: Ranger Trainer
args.text: Keep your distance; let your arrows speak.

args.speaker: Ranger Trainer
args.text: Press C to open your skill tree. Every level brings two skill points.

args.speaker: Warrior Trainer
args.text: Steel and nerve. Stand your ground and cleave through them.

args.speaker: Warrior Trainer
args.text: Press C to open your skill tree. Every level brings two skill points.

args.speaker: Villager
args.text: The smith brews a fine potion.
